local.h: One dead in Six Flags rollercoaster incident

local.b: Loosened federal rules and a lack of prevention funding could put more people at risk of human trafficking in Georgia, which officials call a major trafficking hub.
local.title: Loosened federal rules, lack of prevention funding could put more at risk of human trafficking

local.h: 'Breaking Bad' actor RJ Mitte dies at 34
local.b: RJ Mitte, the 'Breaking Bad' actor and disability rights advocate who had cerebral palsy, has died at 34.
local.title: RJ Mitte, ‘Breaking Bad’ actor and disability rights champion, dies at 34

local.h: SoCal beach towns walloped by Rachel's waves
local.b: Several homes on the Long Beach Peninsula were red-tagged as waves from Tropical Storm Rachel kept slamming the bulkhead Monday.

local.h: Bass, Raman set for only live TV mayoral debate
local.b: Mayor Karen Bass and Councilmember Nithya Raman will face off in the only live televised debate of the Los Angeles mayoral race.

local.h: Long Beach Peninsula faces urgent repairs
local.b: After the bulkhead failed, waves from Tropical Storm Rachel flooded and destroyed several homes on the Peninsula. Conditions are expected to improve through Tuesday.

local.b: Building on its free World Cup watch parties, Los Angeles will host watch parties for the 2028 Olympic Games.

local.b: NYC's taxi union has teamed with Uber and a hedge fund to demand healthcare for drivers after four driver deaths.
local.title: NYC's taxi union teams with Uber, hedge fund to demand healthcare 4 driver deaths

local.h: Hochul declares measles 'disaster' emergency
local.b: Gov. Kathy Hochul declared a disaster emergency over the spread of measles in New York.
local.title: NY measles spread prompts 'disaster' emergency. It didn't have to be this way, health commissioner says.

local.h: Man shot by ICE still has bullet in neck
local.b: The man shot by ICE agents in New York City last week remained in solitary confinement at a Brooklyn federal lockup with a bullet lodged in his neck, his attorneys said.
local.title: Man shot by ICE in NYC still has bullet lodged in neck, attorneys say

local.h: Mamdani orders review of NYPD force policies
local.b: Facing criticism from the left over his approach to policing, Mayor Mamdani announced a comprehensive review of the NYPD's use of force policies.
local.title: Mayor Mamdani orders review of NYPD use of force policies

local.h: NYPD Bomb Squad contractor faced LI scrutiny
local.b: A company that won a $23 million contract to build an NYPD Bomb Squad building in the Bronx was flagged in a 2020 Nassau County inspector general report for not disclosing who ran the business.

local.b: Europe's airports and airlines are demanding changes to the EU's Entry/Exit System, citing 'unacceptable' delays.
local.title: Europe's airports and airlines demand EES rethink as 'unacceptable' delays continue

local.h: Paris protest marches set for Tuesday
local.b: Students, teachers and unions are expected to march in Paris on Tuesday, October 13th. Several metro stations will close starting at 9am.

local.h: France braces for new student demonstrations
local.b: France readied Tuesday for fresh nationwide demonstrations backing students who have protested poor classroom conditions for weeks, amid fears of further violence.
local.title: France braces for new student demonstrations as Greta Thunberg joins protests

local.h: Glucksmann: 'battle begins' to unite the left
local.b: Presidential candidate Raphael Glucksmann launched a bid to unite France's fragmented left ahead of next year's election, hours after a protester flour-bombed him.

local.h: Cyberattack forces supermarket fridge shutdowns
local.b: E. Leclerc, Intermarché and Coopérative U said a cyberattack caused refrigerators to defrost in hundreds of stores, forcing spoiled food to be thrown away.

local.h: Headmaster, teacher shot at school near Marseille
local.b: A 14-year-old was arrested after a headmaster and teacher were shot with a hunting rifle at a middle school in Aubagne. Police said their lives were not in danger.

local.h: Fire destroys Paris's oldest covered market
local.b: An overnight fire destroyed the Marché Couvert des Enfants Rouges in the Marais, a street food venue that has stood in the same space since 1615, authorities said.

local.h: Glucksmann wins centre-left presidential primary
local.b: Euro MP Raphaël Glucksmann won 66 percent of the 120,787 votes in the centre-left primary, becoming its candidate for next year's French presidential election. Socialist leader Olivier Faure was second with 14 percent.

local.h: Five races could reshape WA Supreme Court
local.b: A majority of Washington Supreme Court seats are on the ballot, and the five nonpartisan races are drawing national attention.
local.title: Court watchers have eyes on races to reshape Washington Supreme Court

local.h: Everett weighs folding its buses into Community Transit
local.b: Everett, the only Puget Sound city running its own transit, is considering merging into Community Transit. Officials say it would raise bus service in the city by 50%.

local.h: Scammers used AI to impersonate KUOW reporter
local.b: KUOW's Katie Campbell describes scam emails sent in her name and how to avoid AI impersonation traps.
